chunks: "There is no believing servant who visits the grave of a believer and recites near it
'Indeed, We revealed it on the Night of al-Qadr,'
seven times, except that Allah will forgive him and the occupant of the grave."

key_terms.إِنّٰا أَنْزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ الْقَد: the opening verse of Surah al-Qadr recited at the grave
key_terms.صَاحِبِ الْقَبْرِ: the one buried in the grave

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for reciting Surah al-Qadr at the grave of a believer?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the merit of visiting the grave of a believer and reciting Surah al-Qadr there seven times. It states that Allah grants forgiveness both to the visitor and to the believer buried in the grave, showing the spiritual benefit of Qur'an recitation for the deceased.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.541 - Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha (as) said:
"Whenever a believing servant visits the grave of a believer and recites
'Indeed, We revealed it [the Qur'an] on the Night of Qadr' Surah Al-Qadr (97:1-5)
seven times, Allah (swt) will forgive him and the person buried in the grave”.
